canonical_exclusion.policy: Every canonical public ID and mechanism is excluded regardless of canonical PASS/NARROW/REJECT/UNKNOWN state.

discovery_snapshot.source: GitHub global advisory REST API plus first-party repository advisories and git histories

admission_rule: Accept only a first-party advisory-bound exact AI-causal mechanism origin, or a released AI-authored partial remediation of the same boundary and same mechanism followed by a released fix that closes the residual. Require relevant-hunk provenance, minimum fix-set, canonical duplicate exclusion, and vulnerable/fixed release containment.
decisive_result: No reviewed route meets all admission gates. Ruby/json CVE-2026-71847 is public-ID and mechanism novel but is REJECT because e5fa06aa fixed callback reentrancy before the later stale-buffer-pointer mechanism existed. The comparison shard's Koel admission has strong causal and release evidence but is REJECT here because its NAT64/6to4 SSRF-validator residual duplicates canonical post:n8n-mcp-ipv6-ssrf@canonical. Netty CVE-2026-56818 remains attribution UNKNOWN.

comparison.agreement: Both audits found zero strict AI-origin components.

conflicts.resolution: Independent replay confirms the AI hunk, composite partial, squash topology, and release assets, but canonical CVE-2026-42449/GHSA-56C3-VFP2-5QQJ already fingerprints the same 6to4/NAT64 IPv6-family SSRF-validator residual. The explicit mechanism-exclusion rule controls.

comparison.claim_boundary: The blind set was frozen before this path was opened. The later Koel claim was independently replayed only to adjudicate the comparison conflict and is retained as a negative duplicate, not used as an admission.

limitations: Bounded latest-100-per-ecosystem discovery is not an all-history proof of absence.

Ruby/json dynamic replay was blocked by missing local Ruby development headers; official gem digests, byte-for-byte tagged source containment, and first-party advisory evidence close release containment instead.
Netty's public squash-member metadata did not expose claim-grade AI authorship; UNKNOWN is preserved.

PHP is not installed locally, so the Koel filter_var predicate was not dynamically replayed; immutable release assets and source-level first-party evidence close containment, while the canonical mechanism duplicate independently bars admission.
